defaults.plannedExit: first liquid mark after catalyst or thesis invalidation; otherwise close before expiry week

entries.catalyst: post-IPO option liquidity and first public-market digestion
entries.mechanism: Cerebras is a direct frontier-compute scarcity asset, but post-IPO AGI scarcity premium can also unwind if valuation/customer/software concerns dominate.
entries.falsifier: chain remains too wide, customer concentration dominates, or disclosures fail to support durable frontier-compute demand

entries.catalyst: AI datacenter power-contract headlines, earnings, or guidance update
entries.mechanism: AI scaling shifts bottleneck attention from accelerators to dispatchable power and on-site generation.
entries.falsifier: new disclosures show power demand is already priced or project economics/capacity are weaker than expected

entries.catalyst: HBM/DRAM pricing, earnings, or AI memory supply commentary
entries.mechanism: AI scaling can move the binding constraint into memory bandwidth/capacity faster than consensus cycle models update.
entries.falsifier: pricing, utilization, or guide commentary shows memory scarcity is already fully priced

entries.catalyst: NAND/storage pricing update, earnings, or AI infrastructure storage demand commentary
entries.mechanism: Frontier training and inference scale can reprice storage/NAND scarcity beyond normal cycle framing.
entries.falsifier: pricing or demand commentary fails to support AI-driven storage scarcity

entries.catalyst: capacity, customer, financing, lockup, or utilization update
entries.mechanism: Neocloud capacity is a scarce AI-scaling asset, but financing and customer concentration make the equity fragile.
entries.falsifier: no evidence of capacity scarcity, financing stress dominates, or option IV absorbs the entire distribution

entries.catalyst: datacenter conversion contract, customer demand, power-site update, or financing event
entries.mechanism: Bitcoin-miner power footprints can be repriced as AI datacenter conversion assets.
entries.falsifier: conversion economics or financing fail to validate AI compute reuse

entries.catalyst: semi crowding, capex disappointment, rates shock, or export-control/policy shock
entries.mechanism: The obvious AI beta layer can break on crowding even while the deeper AI-scaling thesis remains intact.
entries.falsifier: breadth and earnings revisions continue to validate crowded semi beta without policy/rates pressure

entries.catalyst: earnings, accelerator supply/capex guide, export-control update, or hyperscaler AI capex revision
entries.mechanism: NVIDIA remains the liquid public proxy for frontier-compute scaling, but obvious AI beta can also mean crowded downside convexity.
entries.falsifier: datacenter accelerator demand or margins decelerate, export controls bind harder than modeled, or option IV fully prices the move

entries.catalyst: AI ASIC/custom silicon demand, networking order commentary, earnings, or hyperscaler capex update
entries.mechanism: Custom accelerators and cluster networking can capture value as frontier labs diversify beyond merchant GPUs.
entries.falsifier: AI ASIC backlog, networking growth, or margin commentary shows the scarcity premium is already priced

entries.catalyst: datacenter power/cooling order update, earnings guide, backlog commentary, or AI capacity buildout headline
entries.mechanism: AI datacenter scaling pushes thermal management and power infrastructure from support equipment into bottleneck assets.
entries.falsifier: orders/backlog or margin commentary fails to show incremental AI datacenter scarcity

entries.catalyst: grid equipment demand, gas/power generation order commentary, earnings, or large datacenter power announcement
entries.mechanism: AI load growth can pull grid and generation equipment demand forward faster than industrial-cycle models update.
entries.falsifier: grid/generation orders do not connect to AI load growth or valuation already embeds the pull-forward

entries.catalyst: electrical equipment backlog, datacenter demand commentary, earnings, or grid-interconnect update
entries.mechanism: Datacenter electrification and grid bottlenecks can extend electrical-equipment pricing power.
entries.falsifier: orders, lead times, or margins normalize enough to invalidate the AI bottleneck premium

entries.catalyst: nuclear/datacenter power-contract news, capacity-pricing update, earnings, or policy support
entries.mechanism: Firm clean power can reprice as a scarce input for AI datacenters and sovereign compute.
entries.falsifier: power contracts, regulation, or capacity pricing fail to convert AI load growth into equity value

entries.catalyst: AI cluster networking demand, Ethernet fabric adoption, earnings, or hyperscaler capex commentary
entries.mechanism: Scale-out AI clusters can bottleneck on networking fabric as much as on accelerators.
entries.falsifier: customer concentration or guide commentary shows AI networking growth is already fully priced

entries.catalyst: custom silicon ramps, optical/DSP/networking demand, earnings, or customer update
entries.mechanism: AI scale-out creates demand for custom silicon and networking components beyond headline GPU suppliers.
entries.falsifier: custom silicon ramps slip or networking demand fails to offset non-AI cyclicality

entries.catalyst: NAND/HDD pricing update, AI infrastructure storage demand commentary, earnings, or supply discipline news
entries.mechanism: AI training/inference data pipelines can tighten storage markets beyond normal cycle framing.
entries.falsifier: storage pricing or utilization fails to show AI-linked scarcity

entries.catalyst: nearline demand, cloud storage commentary, earnings, or AI data-retention infrastructure update
entries.mechanism: AI data growth can support higher-value storage demand and extend storage-cycle pricing power.
entries.falsifier: nearline/cloud demand weakens or AI storage demand fails to reach public-equity cash flows

entries.catalyst: AI/HPC hosting contract, power-site monetization update, financing event, or datacenter conversion milestone
entries.mechanism: Bitcoin-miner power access can be repriced as AI/HPC datacenter capacity if conversion economics validate.
entries.falsifier: financing, conversion capex, or customer demand fails to validate AI compute reuse

entries.catalyst: AI datacenter lease/customer update, financing event, power-site progress, or utilization disclosure
entries.mechanism: AI datacenter scarcity can reprice smaller power/site operators, while financing and execution risk keep downside live.
entries.falsifier: customer demand, financing, or buildout execution fails to support AI datacenter optionality

entries.catalyst: defense AI contract, government AI policy, earnings, or enterprise AI deployment commentary
entries.mechanism: If AI becomes national-security infrastructure, secure government/enterprise AI platforms can retain scarcity value.
entries.falsifier: government/enterprise AI demand fails to convert into durable revenue or valuation already embeds the security premium

entries.catalyst: AI-beta crowding, rates shock, capex digestion, earnings breadth deterioration, or policy/export-control shock
entries.mechanism: The broad AI/growth beta layer can sell off even if the long-run AI-scaling thesis remains intact.
entries.falsifier: market breadth and earnings revisions continue to validate AI/growth beta without rates or policy pressure
